notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
(server side)
- npc's would randomly spit out error messages due to memory issues on server(fixed)
- occasional immediate crashing of game scene (fixed)

notes.title: Language Algorithm Change (patch)
notes.content: - Game dialog should be working somewhat properly now. The characters still may fall into speech loops here and there but not as much as before.

notes.title: Language Algorithm Change
notes.content: The old algorithm was a bit incoherent at times and often speech fell out of context. The depth of subject matters within conversations has considerably deepened compared to previously. This update is occurred server-side and has taken effect as of now.
